title: OAuth Login CSRF (Missing PKCE and State Validation)
historic_cve_justification: CVE-2025-56400 (Tuya SDK 6.5.0, Android/iOS): Missing OAuth state parameter validation during account linking. Attacker crafts authorization link; victim click completes OAuth flow on attacker's behalf. Here: removed PKCE + state validation enables deep link injection of attacker's auth code, forcing victim device to authenticate as attacker account.
